newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's NSW has cumulative budget surplus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's NSW has cumulative budget surplus.

text.p: The New South Wales budget for the seven months to January showed showed a surplus of A$131 million, down A$55 million from the previous corresponding period, state treasurer Michael Egan said on Friday.
The result was consistent with the state government's target of a small surplus for the 1996/1997 fiscal year ending June 30, Egan said in a statement.
"The budget 'headline' result for the seven months ... is a surplus of A$93 million, compared to a surplus of A$164 million for the same period last year," he said.
"This comprises a surplus of A$1,310 million on the current account and a deficit of A$1,217 million on the capital account.
"On an underlying basis, the financial result is a surplus of A$131 million compared with a surplus of A$186 million for the same period last year," he said.
